reviews.title: Great PSU, Great price
reviews.comment: Great PSU at an affordable price. In used this in my recent build and could not be happier. Packaging is really great, almost to much lol. It's very well protected on it's way to your door. Ready to install. Comes with a handy tester to ensure the PSU is functioning prior to installation. It's very quiet. Seems to run fairly cool also. Plenty of cables to connect all of your components. Great unit, great price.
reviews.author: Dustin Lathen

reviews.title: Awesome psu for the price
reviews.comment: Works perfect for my setup. I have an am5 build I went all out on (and spent too much money on as well, oops) but I built a second pc on the am4 platform to have as a secondary computer. I was skeptical about this psu when comparing to other brands, but I wanted to keep my cost lower. This thing is great, honestly I’m beyond happy with it. I can’t even hear the fan spinning in the slightest. It came with every cord I needed and then some. Super easy to hook up and figure out, even being a noobie pc builder like myself. This is great for a budget pc build or an alternative to bigger name brands! 10/10.
reviews.author: Isaac

reviews.title: Great PSU backed with warranty
reviews.comment: This PSU is pretty quiet and sits there delivering the right amount of power to your PC components. It lasted until two years when something inside started rattling, which became notoriously loud under heavy GPU load, though it was still stable in delivering power. I will still give this 5 stars because ARESGAME sent a new higher wattage unit in response, as a product's rating should also involve the manufacturer's guarantee in making you still have a working product in the end.

reviews.title: Great quality for price!
reviews.comment: Great deal purchased at $84 and could not be happier! It works just as intended and does not have any defects! It brings nothing but stable connections and the connection is easy to setup.
